```yaml
name: Update Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install nox

      - name: Run lint and tests
        run: nox -s lint tests

      - name: Remove leftover submodule
        run: |
          if [ -d open-webui/.git ]; then
            rm -rf open-webui/.git
          fi

      - name: Clone Open WebUI
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 --no-checkout https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui
          cd open-webui
          git checkout main
          rm -rf .git

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          DOCS_FILE=docs/CONTRIBUTING.md
          if [ -f "$DOCS_FILE" ]; then
            echo "" >> "$DOCS_FILE"
            echo "## Open WebUI" >> "$DOCS_FILE"
            echo "- The Open WebUI repository is now included in this project as a shallow copy." >> "$DOCS_FILE"
          else
            echo "## Open WebUI" > "$DOCS_FILE"
            echo "- The Open WebUI repository is now included in this project as a shallow copy." >> "$DOCS_FILE"
          fi

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          if grep -q "Automated sync" README.md; then
            echo "Automated sync already mentioned."
          else
            echo "" >> README.md
            echo "### Automated Sync" >> README.md
            echo "- This repository automatically syncs the Open WebUI repository weekly." >> README.md
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: 'docs/CONTRIBUTING.md README.md open-webui'
          message: 'chore: sync open-webui and update docs'
          default_author: github_actions
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
